name: UI：店铺信息配置-分页功能验证
description: 验证分页组件存在且可翻页

steps.expression: (() => { const pagination = document.querySelector('.ant-pagination'); const total = pagination?.querySelector('.ant-pagination-total-text')?.textContent?.trim() || ''; const items = pagination?.querySelectorAll('.ant-pagination-item')?.length || 0; const nextBtn = pagination?.querySelector('.ant-pagination-next'); return { hasPagination: !!pagination, totalText: total, pageCount: items, hasNext: !!nextBtn, nextDisabled: nextBtn?.classList?.contains('ant-pagination-disabled') }; })()
(() => { const page2 = document.querySelector('.ant-pagination-item[title="2"]'); if(page2) { page2.click(); return 'clicked page 2'; } return 'no page 2'; })()
(() => { const active = document.querySelector('.ant-pagination-item-active'); return { activePage: active?.getAttribute('title') || active?.textContent?.trim() || '' }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在超过10条店铺配置
